**Describe the bug/issue with as much details as you can.**
 
 
Ideally, you'd describe what happens, when/how it happens, and which version you are using,  but write _the way you feel the most comfortable_, we'll ask questions if needed.   
If you prefer using screenshots, that is 100% OK here.    



The English language is preferred, but we understand French, Spanish, Dutch and German as well.  

It's better to write in your own language than to use a translator.
